seo.title: TalentCo HR Website UI Design | Shubham Pendse
seo.description: A recruitment website UI concept by Shubham Pendse, structured around employer and job-seeker journeys.

sections.heading: Project overview
sections.body: This desktop website concept explores how an HR services brand can serve employers and job seekers from one clear starting point. The page combines recruitment pathways, current openings, service information, sector coverage and trust signals in a single visual system.

sections.heading: Interface direction
sections.body: The concept focuses on making a content-heavy recruitment website easier to scan.

items.title: Two audiences, two entry points
items.body: Employer and candidate actions are separated early so each audience can identify its next step quickly.

items.title: Jobs remain visible
items.body: Current openings sit near the beginning of the experience instead of being buried behind a secondary page.

items.title: Proof supports the service story
items.body: Industry coverage, achievements, testimonials and client logos reinforce credibility as visitors move down the page.

sections.heading: Scope note
sections.body: This project focused on desktop visual UI and information hierarchy. It is presented as a UI design concept and does not claim formal user research, usability testing or measured product outcomes.
